proves: Each credited line was returned, numbered and byte-equal to the frozen workspace file, in a tool_result paired with a Read or line-numbered content-mode Grep call of the hash-bound provider stream.
does_not_prove: Attention, understanding, or retention: a credited line may have been skimmed, ignored, or dropped by context compaction before the report was written. Uncredited lines may still have been seen in a form the ledger cannot attribute (previews, unnumbered output, subagents).
image_proves: Each delivered image: a direct Read tool_use of its exact workspace path, in the stream's session, is paired by id with a tool_result (same session) whose content is one inline base64 image block of the declared media type, and the base64 decodes to bytes whose sha256 is the declared one.
image_does_not_prove: That the model looked at, understood or correctly interpreted the image, or any scientific acceptance of what it shows: only delivery of these exact bytes. Transformed or resized content, metadata and self-reports earn nothing, so an undelivered image may still have been seen in another form.
